All truncated covariance, conditional drift and fourth remainder quantities are the archive actual copy-array definitions. Four coordinate moments discharge first/L2 and endpoint integrability; no symmetry of X, identical-law, coordinate independence, spectral lower bound or covariance inverse is required.

The exponential-clock mixture is an actual random-rectangle average. Positive and negative discrepancy directions use expansion/contraction.
